rules.name: Safety & Quality Hold Precedence
rules.description: Quality Control defect threshold breaches take immediate precedence over production & logistics schedules.

rules.name: Emergency Maintenance Line Lockout
rules.description: Critical bearing vibration or overheating takes precedence over production output targets to prevent catastrophic breakdown.

rules.name: Production Batch Target
rules.description: Standard batch scheduling runs when machine health is green and quality variance is acceptable.

rules.name: Logistics Dispatch Alignment
rules.description: Logistics dispatch operates based on confirmed finished goods inventory and available docks.
